description: Defines generic delegate types named 'Factory' that create instances of type TInstance with varying numbers of input parameters, used for dependency injection or factory patterns within the Orleans project.

classes.name: Factory`1
classes.description: A delegate for creating instances of type TInstance with no parameters.

classes.name: Factory`2
classes.description: A delegate for creating instances of type TInstance with one parameter of type TParam1.

classes.name: Factory`3
classes.description: A delegate for creating instances of type TInstance with two parameters of types TParam1 and TParam2.
